10 marks in the CHRIST BBA paper come from Fundamental Accounting. Start with the golden rules 👇

Personal account: debit the receiver, credit the giver.
Real account: debit what comes in, credit what goes out.
Nominal account: debit expenses and losses, credit incomes and gains.

And the one equation: Assets = Liabilities + Capital.

Try it: you paid rent in cash. Which account is debited? Comment your answer 👇
